stem: Which sentence from the selection shows that Wignall's project has expanded over the years?

options.label: F
options.text: She and other volunteers placed these items in bags to give to children who needed them.

options.label: G
options.text: After the bags are filled, they are sent to the children who need them.

options.label: H
options.text: Volunteers who sew make the bags that hold the donated items and also make other things that are included in the bags, such as blankets and bibs.

options.label: J
options.text: Thanks to these kits, about 70 other Care Bags programs have been started.
